heuristics.scope: Expected per_a0=14.38217929656983452650...; claws/a0=160*E/2^32, C1-claws/a0=20*E/2^32, E in [35,546,342, 35,641,736]. heuristics.statement: The first blocks M0 are fresh uniform 512-bit strings and their chaining values cv = F_38(IV, M0) behave as independent uniform 256-bit values. Consequences used: (a) for every a0, F(a0) = Cc2 + a0 + k0 + h(a0) is uniform and independent of h(a0) and of the epoch's table (cv[7] enters k0 additively and nothing else; cv[6] enters h(a0) additively), and cv[0] is uniform given both; hence y = R16H[0] - r - F(a0) is uniform, a window probes with probability 202/8192, a probe makes 3120/101 reads, the expected claw count of an a0 is 160 E / 2^32 for the table's E retained entries (Lemma C), and a claw's a1 = u - h(a0) is uniform and independent of the claw event, so a claw passes C1 with probability 1/8 (proof.md Sections 3.6, 5, 6); (b) given the epoch's table, the works W_j and the success counts X_j of distinct chaining values are independent (Lemma 3, Section 7). For each retained entry separately, H1 gives 160/2^32 expected claws and 20/2^32 expected C1 claws per scanned a0. Every bucket holds a prefix of at most six lanes; weights 6,6,6,8,8,8 sum to at most 7p for population p. Thus the ordered-tree mean charge is at most 7 per C1 claw for every fixed table, without independence between lanes or conditioning cost on success.

In this filing C1 is decided inside the bucket test (Lemma B''), so the procedure processes the C1-claws (one eighth of the claws) and the rates P(C2 | C1) = 8 x 53,096,854 / 2^32 and P(C2 G | C1) set the remaining chain cost; the good-pair set is unchanged (Lemma C1). With the window (Section 3.7) the G rate is the exact count over SEL, P(G | C1 C2, SEL) = 2,051,404,269,120 / (2^20 x 53,096,854) = 0.0368453386, and F7 stays at |F7|/2^32: q_pf(SEL) = 2^-15.0022. heuristics.statement: A good pair of the u-table procedure is accepted by step 3b with probability q3r >= q3_P1 x 2^32 / 160 = 2^-71.4010, where q3_P1 = 2^-96.0791 = q3_model x 2^D_LB: q3_model = 2^-96.0133 is the registered accepted-event rate of the A0-variant good pairs on P8 before row 16 and D_LB = -0.0658 is the registered one-sided 99% lower bound of the paired per-seed difference L(P1) - L(A0) measured with the P1 law of the window W9 = [9 x 2^26, 10 x 2^26) (a0 uniform in W9 given G, a1 uniform on C1 and C2). Every a0 the procedure scans lies in W9 (the restriction to the sub-blocks SEL of W9 is the separate premise H8), its claws' a1 are uniform (H1) and its good pairs have the measured (a0, a1) law; their u = W1 is a retained table word, uniformly thinned by the epoch's rotation r (Lemma S) and retained by the arc law (H7). Two inherited transfer premises are part of this heuristic and are stated in proof.md Section 9: (a) the relaxation gain (+0.41488 bit for not imposing E18 = E17), measured on the A0-variant family, is the same for the P1 family, whose paired difference D_LB was measured on the printed event; (b) q3 does not depend on the re-weighting of a1 by its G count n(a1), the difference between the R9 list law (a1 uniform on C1 and C2, then a0 given G) and the u-table's joint law. (c) For the second-order term of the epoch argument only, the average acceptance a-bar of good pairs with uniform W1 is at most 2^10 q3r = 2^-61.40 (the one-sided 99% upper readings of the same registered runs give 2^-70.88). Lemma T then bounds the acceptance of every table's good pairs by 2^6.9169 a-bar, because each table holds at least 35,546,342 of the 2^32 words and acceptance is nonnegative.

heuristics.statement: The sequential Monte Carlo estimator traillab (the lineage's own C tool, not shipped), with which q3_model and the paired difference D_LB were measured, estimates the accepted-event rate of the stated model without material bias. It replays every sample on real 38-step compressions of both members (0 replay mismatches required), treats rows 16..21 as the importance-split prefix (8,192 particles, 256 proposals per row; the row-16 stage is exact with weight 160/2^32) and counts EXACT (zero output difference after step 37) in the window rows 22..37. Its per-seed values, combined by the registered one-sided rules, give conservative bounds for the true rate.

heuristics.statement: Each epoch draws r uniform on [0, 2^13) and ustart uniform on 32 bits; a word u is covered with probability exactly 96/8192 (Lemma S), and a covered u is retained iff it is among the first six covered words of its bucket in the cyclic order from ustart (the arc law: over ustart, retention depends on the bucket's population and the positions of its words in the cyclic order). The number of retained entries E lies in [35,546,342, 35,641,736] for every r (exhaustive over all 8192 r and all 2^32 words). For a fixed r the covered words lie in 96 of the 8192 classes of P(u) mod 2^13; Lemma S's uniformity holds averaged over r. Premise: averaged over (r, ustart), the acceptance of a good pair (rows 17..37) is independent of the coverage class and the retention of its u, so the expected number of accepted pairs per chaining value is the expected claw count times q_pf times q3r.
